method: Ordinary photographs and the standard viewer PMTiles/Mapzen inputs. Existing restoration dimensions retained; no further bespoke research.

pictures.view: Humpback approach, traction strips, parapet and metal guards; viewed only, no pixels copied.
Side intrados, pale stone joints, two cornices, rising parapet and metal guards; viewed only, no pixels copied.

features.note: The extract keeps zooms 0-maxLevel, so the archive also carries layers the app never reads: landcover (zoom 0-7), earth, boundaries and places.

dataLicenses.appliesTo: roads, buildings, water, landuse, earth, boundaries, places, pois

elevation.subseaPolicy: Negative Terrarium values are flattened to the sea/lake surface datum (0 m); this fixture does not encode bathymetry.
elevation.attribution: Mapzen; terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

limitations: Photograph pixels are neither retained nor used as textures. The river-stage reference and fine architectural ordinates remain reconstructed. Standard terrain does not resolve the high quay/approach levels.
